_doc.purpose: Localization companion for media_session.json (Job_MediaSession's session commands). Holds en-us entries.

en-us.com_media_watch: While a movie session is running, watch together in its room. Each one lasts a short while - leave midway and come back any time.
en-us.com_media_play: While a gaming session is running, play together in its room. Each one lasts a short while - leave midway and come back any time.
